bandReport.notes: Written paper, MM 200: Part A Q1-Q20 at 5 marks ('PART A (20 x 5 = 100 MARKS)'), Part B Q21-Q30 at 10 marks ('PART-B (10 X 10 MARKS)'); every question is marked as a whole, so one row each. No column crops exist for this paper; read from the whole-page images (single-column layout). Light 'aglasem.com' watermark ignored; it hides nothing. Labels kept as printed, including 'Q 20' and 'Q 24' with a space. Q6: English asks 'the age of the students?' (kept verbatim); the Hindi asks the age of THAT student. Q9: English prints 'Rs. 111 per square meter', Hindi prints 'Ru. 11'; English is clearly legible and kept, flagged UNCLEAR for the conflict. Q16: English prints '14 cm' (and the figure says 14cm), Hindi prints 24; 14 kept. English 'ircles' typo kept verbatim. Q19: the English line stops without a question ('...selling prie of 16 mangoes.'); the Hindi line adds 'to labh pratishat bataiye' (find the profit percent), so 'Find the profit percent.' is appended from the Hindi. Q22: both English and Hindi print '\angle CBA' twice (60 and 45 degrees); a printed defect, kept verbatim and flagged UNCLEAR. Q28: English prints 'He sold none at a loss of 10%' (kept verbatim); the Hindi says he sold ONE TV at a 10% loss. Spelling errors ('folloing', 'lenght', 'prie', 'Tow', 'tow', 'consist', 'weight 0.8gm.?') kept verbatim.
